description: Reads one MIDAS database table (GET /db/<TABLE>) from the open model, e.g. NODE, ELEM, SECT, GRUP, STLD, STAG, LLAN, MVLDBS, LCOM-GEN. Returns rows keyed by id: the ids asked for, or the first `limit` rows. Read-only.

ids.description: Row ids to return. Omit for the first `limit` rows.

table.description: Table key, e.g. NODE, ELEM, GRUP, STAG.

name: civil_read_table
title: Read a CIVIL NX table
